---
# Copy this file to src/content/projects/<short-id>.md (lowercase, dashes; the file name is the project id).
title: "Project Name"
order: 100               # lower numbers are listed first; the first few appear on the home page
topics:
  - "First topic"
  - "Second topic"
surveys:                 # optional; participant links (Google Forms: Send → link icon). With several, visitors are randomly assigned one.
  - "https://forms.gle/..."
status: ""               # optional label, e.g. "Recruiting". Delete the line if not needed.
methods: []              # optional tags, e.g. ["Online survey", "Longitudinal"]
draft: false             # true hides the project
---
